title: start_dispute
description: Open the dispute form for the transaction currently shown in detail, pre-filled with that transaction's amount, date and merchant. Use this once the customer has confirmed they want to dispute the selected charge. This only reveals and pre-fills the form; it fills none of the customer-provided reason fields and it does not submit anything.

transactionId.description: Opaque id of the transaction to dispute. When unset, the app disputes the transaction currently open in detail.
